content.what_it_is: GLOBAL is the saved shared-state module for FUNWAVE (L63-L410). It declares MPI Cartesian topology/rank data, station buffers and timers; filenames and input controls; Runge-Kutta coefficients and grid/time/wet-dry controls; hydrodynamic, flux-reconstruction, derivative, dispersion and mask arrays; wavemaker/spectral, friction, sponge, mixing/statistics, bathymetry and output state; absorbing-generation and breaking fields; and WK_NEW_IRR coherence work arrays. It contains no procedures.
entities: MPI scalars/topology/ranges L69-L81; station state L84-L87; timers L90-L91
configuration character fields L97-L117; hot-start and missing-file flags L119-L125
Runge-Kutta alpha/beta and Kappa L128-L130; grid/time/counter/depth controls L134-L154
bathymetry/breakwater and coordinates L156-L164; dispersion controls L168-L181
allocatable reconstructed/derivative/time-level/flux/state arrays L184-L220; wet-dry diagnostics L220-L221
wavemaker and spectrum state L223-L252; friction/roller L254-L260; sponge L263-L266
mixing, mean, radiation, wave-height and bathymetry state L270-L298
output flags L302-L328; periodic/obstacle/sponge/breaking/slope switches L333-L345
absorbing wave-series arrays L348-L359; breaking/sponge/limiter/blowup/steady-time state L362-L388
WK_NEW_IRR loop bounds, coordinates and alpha_c L402-L405
unresolved: The module sets MPI Cartesian reorder=.true. at L78, while misc.f90 passes the MPI_COMM_WORLD rank myid to MPI_CART_COORDS and builds ProcessorID/world-rank mappings without obtaining the reordered comm2d rank. This confirms a cross-file communicator/rank-interface mismatch: any actual reorder can assign wrong coordinates, tile ranges, neighbors and point-to-point destinations.

EtaBlowVal is declared without initialization at L384. In io.f90 its READ_FLOAT is commented and an unrelated stale ierr condition controls a 10.0 assignment; CHECK_BLOWUP later always compares against EtaBlowVal. Unless another initialization routine always assigns it, the stability check can use undefined data.

OUT_Time is the only flag in its declaration group without a module initializer at L315-L318. READ_INPUT normally supplies .FALSE. on a missing key, but any use before or on a failed/partial READ_INPUT path differs from every adjacent output flag and can observe an undefined logical.

Several module initializers conflict with READ_INPUT's absent-key defaults: MinDepth 0.001/MinDepthFrc 0.5/CFL 0.15/FroudeCap 10/SWE_ETA_DEP 0.7 at L149-L154 versus io.f90 assignments 0.1/0.1/0.5/3.0/0.8; DISPERSION .FALSE. at L177 versus .TRUE.; Csp 0.15 and CDsponge 0.0 at L378-L379 versus 0.1 and 5.0. The routine-level values overwrite them only after their reads, making pre-read consumers and alternate initialization paths configuration-dependent.
